text: Block 1 can never make a word.|So I park it *bottom right*.
B, S, A, R. Turn it, slide it,|drop it next to block 1...
K, M, O, T. Hmm.|Where can this go?
*TORS!* And the game says|that was the *best possible drop*.
E and R on top of the M...|*HEM!* Three in a row.
R, E, B, T. This one's tricky.
Turning it... and turning it...|I can't see a word anywhere.
Fine. I'll leave the R and E|up there for later.
Streak gone. The best drop was 120.|*I missed it.* Ouch.
But that R and E paid off:|*RED!*
N, G, H, I...|*GIT!* Two in a row.
B, A, S, C. Rotate, drop...|*BAN!* That's three.
Two more words for the|*streak bonus*. Come on...
Five in a row: *STREAK BONUS +300!*|210 to 690 in one drop.
Last block, empty board, no word.|*690* on my last try.
